text: Gameplay is a little repetitive - jump down, find guns, kill maybe five or six other players then get knocked out just as you think you'll win this round. Still, that's to be expected of a battle royale game, so I'm not complaining. I was about to suggest a PvE mode as well, but it looks like you've added that anyways, so... graphics could be a little better, and maybe a larger phrasebook (so to speak) for those of us without microphones. The default voice should be customizable as well.

Okay, so, this is GOOD. IT'S meh, not amazing. Controls are fairly good but shooting and hit detection as well as damage can be abit shaky sometimes. Game suffers from frame drops occasionally, especially in heated gunfight and even the best graphics aren't great. Crates bought with money are shoved into every hole your body has but those are purely cosmetic, even still you can get cool cosmetic items just by playing. Maps are massive and diverse, each with unique weapons, cars and weather.

Exceptional game. Oh wow, what a game. I was late to the Battle Royal game party, and I've still no idea what Fortnite is all about. This was my first foray into PUBG and it's sensational. Feels really realistic to me. Not spent a penny on it and I'm not sure why you would need to unless you really want a funny hat. Maybe I'm missing something. Nice to have a game with a bit of substance on the phone that doesn't bombard you with freemium content and limit gaming sessions with energy. Headphones essential, and don't bother starting a game unless you have a free 20 minutes at least, you'll need it to win a game. Stick with the game through the early levels when rookie players and bots make it a bit too easy. Get up to the silver and gold levels and you'll really start to enjoy the challenge and need to start thinking about your tactics. Squad matches are a bit hit and miss when playing with strangers, depending on your teammates ability. But it just adds more variety.
